title: Nilgiri: PDU-28 Rev B brownout on cold restart
description: Two PDU-28 Rev B controllers at Nilgiri Aero Systems restarted after a brownout during a cold morning start. Units run firmware 2.2.

comments.author: Sai
comments.body: Root cause: firmware 2.2 waits 4 ms for power-good; the regulator soft-start needs up to 4 ms plus margin. Fixed in pmic_seq.c (FW-233).

comments.author: Nagarjun
comments.body: Firmware 2.3.1 deployed to all 220 Rev B units at Nilgiri. Closing.
